title: refactor(ui)!: retire zero-consumer exports from @object-ui/plugin-gantt and @object-ui/plugin-designer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbEi5wvRAxyvWna4gbUTJroF)_

Part of #25921 — the zero-consumer barrel batch for `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` and `@object-ui/plugin-designer` (claim 6576816381), the item landings 6542309053 and 6543370760 left open. The card stays open: every other item it lists is untouched.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/plugin-gantt` 入口不再导出 19 个名字（快速筛选栏、资源负载网格、负载计算、班次带工具及其类型、`normalizeDependencies`）；`@object-ui/plugin-designer` 入口不再导出 6 个值（`CollaborationProvider`、`ConnectionStatusIndicator`、`useClipboard`、`useMultiSelect`、`useCanvasPanZoom`、`PropertyEditor`）。模块文件全部保留，两个 README 不再教这些名字，每包一个 `!` changeset。
- 为什么改：这 25 个名字在全仓（含 examples、文档、技能、测试）和 hotcrm 中，除自己包外零引用；甘特图和设计器内部照常使用它们，只是不再作为没人用的公开面发布。
- 风险与回滚：仓内无消费者，Console 与其它 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响；外部 npm 用户若导入会在升级时编译报错，changeset 写明每个名字改用的写法（多数是在 `gantt` 块里声明 `quickFilters` / `resourceView` / `timeSegments`）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`、`ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/index.tsx`、`.changeset/25921-plugin-designer-internal-helpers-off-entry.md`（协作入口退出后，设计器里的协作分支在包外不可达）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -w -e QuickFilterBar -e computeWorkload -e CollaborationProvider -e useCanvasPanZoom -- ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/index.tsx ui/packages/plugin-gantt/README.md ui/packages/plugin-designer/README.md`，预期无输出（退出码 1）：两个入口和两个 README 都不再出现这些名字。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（入队前欠一次契约复审档的复审，由席位转总监）。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` (`src/index.tsx`): the entry stops exporting `QuickFilterBar`, `QuickFilterBarProps`, `QuickFilterField`, `QuickFilterOption`, `QuickFilterLabels`, `QuickFilterDef`, `ResourceWorkload`, `ResourceWorkloadProps`, `computeWorkload`, `WorkloadColumn`, `WorkloadOptions`, `ResourceCell`, `ResourceLoad`, `normalizeDependencies`, `normalizeShiftSegments`, `shiftDayStart`, `bandAt`, `ShiftSegmentsConfig` and `ShiftBandConfig`. Every module stays: `ObjectGantt` still imports the bar, the grid and the shift helpers, and `ResourceWorkload` still imports the workload math.
- `@object-ui/plugin-designer` (`src/index.tsx`): the entry stops exporting `CollaborationProvider`, `ConnectionStatusIndicator`, `useClipboard`, `useMultiSelect`, `useCanvasPanZoom` and `PropertyEditor`. Every module stays: the four designers import the hooks, `PropertyEditor` and `useCollaboration` from them.
- Both `README.md` files stop teaching the retired names (`check-readme-exports` binds every README self-import to a real export). The gantt README now says the bar, the workload grid and the shift bands are configured through the `gantt` block; the designer README drops the collaboration feature bullet, its section and the Quick Start wrapper.
- Two changesets, `patch` with the `**BREAKING**` banner, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` marker naming every operand, and a FROM → TO "no replacement" line with the one-line fix per group. New file names, distinct from the `25921-*` changesets #26517 still holds.

## Why

How the set was chosen, the #28385 method re-run at `origin/main` `738971d2` (hotcrm `d4ffe99`): every name each barrel exports was listed from the barrel's AST (35 / 38), then `git grep -l -w -F` ran for each over the whole tree minus the package's own directory, `**/CHANGELOG.md`, the lockfiles, `.changeset/**` and `ui/.changeset/**`; the brief's cut (`ui/`, `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, `content/`, tests excluded) and hotcrm were counted beside it. Positive controls, same command: `ObjectGantt` 108 files (the #28385 reading), `CreateAppPage` 48, `SchemaRenderer` 1157 (hotcrm 3). A name was retired only when all three hold:

1. zero hits outside its package on every cut (any hit, prose included, keeps the name);
2. no in-package module loses its last importer (no module file is deleted);
3. no export that stays needs it, measured with the TypeScript checker over the declared signatures of every kept export.

| package | barrel names | zero hits outside | of those, needed by a kept export | retired here |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` | 35 | 24 | 5 | 19 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-designer` | 38 | 15 | 9 | 6 |

Kept by rule 3: `GanttViewProps` (props of `GanttView`), `GanttDependency` and `GanttDependencyObject` (`GanttTask.dependencies`), `NormShiftSegments` and `NormShiftBand` (`GanttViewProps.shiftSegments`); the nine designer `…Props` types of components that stay.

## Tests

- Code head `641e44d3`; `bb4ab640` merges 21 `origin/main` commits, none under either package (branch delta re-read: the same 6 files, +71 / -107).
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-gantt --filter=@object-ui/plugin-designer --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/console` → 74/74 tasks successful (os-verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`). app-shell (the lazy designer pages) and the Console are the importers of either package.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-gantt/ packages/plugin-designer/` → Test Files 156 passed, 1 skipped (157); Tests 1248 passed, 114 skipped (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (includes `check-readme-exports`) → Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 4903 passed (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- Full dogfood battery (the title carries `!`) on `bb4ab640`: closure `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/dogfood^...` 68/68, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` → Test Files 393 passed, 3 skipped (396); Tests 3243 passed, 28 skipped (3271); `VERDICT command-exit 0`, held the lock 2236 s.
- Head `d0ee5c76` merges 29 more `origin/main` commits, none under either package; the census re-run on it still reads zero for all 25 retired names (control `ObjectGantt` 108). The suites above were not re-run on it.
- No ablation: export lines and README text removed; no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- With `CollaborationProvider` off the entry, nothing outside the package can mount it, so the collaboration branches in `PageDesigner`, `DataModelDesigner`, `ProcessDesigner` and `ReportDesigner` (`useCollaboration()` is now always `null` for a host) and the provider and indicator bodies in `CollaborationProvider.tsx` are dead code. Deleting them edits modules this claim does not cover; same card family, left for a next pass.
- `useConfirmDialog` and `VersionHistory` have zero hits once tests are excluded; their only outside hits are comments in `ui/scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` naming their module files. Kept under rule 1 here.
- Gantt names kept with outside hits: `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectGanttProps`, `ObjectGanttRenderer`, `GanttView`, `GanttTask`, `GanttTaskType`, `GanttViewMode`, `GanttLinkType`, `GanttMarker`, `normalizeTaskType`, `parseHHMM` (several are prose or same-name hits, for example `parseHHMM` in `service-messaging`; rule 1 keeps them all).
- A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue (barrel narrowing); the seat routes it to the director.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates — 28/28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `641e44d3`: 28 commands; `--ran`: "28 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 28 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Every command exit 0, among them `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-sdui-manifest` and its `--self-test`, `check:published-files`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:nul-bytes` and `vitest run scripts/`. `check-comment-mask-corpus` first timed out at 300 s beside the closure build, then exit 0 alone (20050 files, 0 disagree, 284 s).

Outside the derived set: `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (0 anchored files) at `bb4ab640`. `dispatch-gates`: 178 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold; no governed path.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `eslint` on the two changed barrels exits 0 (7 warnings, 0 errors: `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the kept helper exports and one `no-explicit-any`, all present on `main` before this diff); the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
